text: In tissue culture, the ratio of the two hormones decides what a lump of callus becomes. More auxin than cytokinin: roots. About equal: the callus just keeps growing. More cytokinin than auxin: shoots. This is Skoog and Miller's result from nineteen fifty-seven, and it is the most commonly reversed fact in this chapter.
